newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-HAESSLER OUT AGAIN AFTER BREAKING LEG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HAESSLER OUT AGAIN AFTER BREAKING LEG.

text.p: Karlsruhe midfielder Thomas Haessler broke his left leg in training on Thursday and could be out of action for the rest of the season, his club said.
The German international had only just returned to the Bundesliga side after recovering from a complex ankle fracture which he sustained in November.
"It's a complete catastrophe. This is a bolt out of the blue," Karlsruhe president Roland Schmider said.
The news is also a big blow to the German national side, where the 30-year-old forms a formidable midfield partnership with Borussia Dortmund's Andy Moeller.
